trust_tiers.primary: Official project, vendor, standards, or source documentation. Prefer for factual claims and current behavior.

metadata.default_source_policy: Use official engine docs first for behavior and syntax. Verify release-sensitive features, cloud limits, and managed-service behavior against current primary docs before recommendations.

Use the release announcement and the pg18 release notes (release-18.html) for exact behavior; verify specifics against official docs.

high_signal_guides.name: LITHE: A Query Rewrite Advisor using LLMs (EDBT 2026)
high_signal_guides.description: LLM-based SQL query rewrite research. arXiv 2502.12918 (submitted 2025-02-18, NOT a 2026 arXiv). Published at EDBT 2026. The published abstract and section 1 report slow-query geometric-mean runtime speedups on TPC-DS / PostgreSQL of 13.2x for LITHE and 4.9x for SOTA, each against the native optimizer. Use for framing LLM-assisted query rewriting; verify reproducibility claims independently before citing in recommendations.

high_signal_guides.name: pgvector GitHub — Releases and Documentation
high_signal_guides.description: pgvector 0.8.x release notes and index tuning guidance. Authoritative source for HNSW/IVFFlat parameters, filtered ANN behavior (0.8+ planner improvements), and managed-service availability. Check for current version before advising on specific index types or query patterns. pgvector has HNSW and IVFFlat only — DiskANN comes from pgvectorscale or pg_diskann.

high_signal_guides.name: MySQL 9.7 — HyperGraph Optimizer Available in Community Edition
high_signal_guides.description: Oracle announcement confirming HyperGraph optimizer availability in MySQL 9.7 Community Edition (April 2026). Not enabled by default; opt-in per session. Use for framing optimizer discussion; verify exact syntax and defaults against MySQL 9.7 reference manual.

high_signal_guides.name: pgvectorscale (StreamingDiskANN)
high_signal_guides.description: Separate extension providing the StreamingDiskANN index on top of pgvector; do not attribute DiskANN to pgvector itself.

books.name: SQL Performance Explained (Markus Winand)
books.description: Cross-engine indexing and execution-plan fundamentals. Used for: access vs filter predicates (ch. 2, ch. 5), index clustering factor (ch. 5 pp. 113-119), index-only scan fragility (ch. 5 pp. 116-121), pipelined ORDER BY and top-N (ch. 7 pp. 143-147), keyset/seek pagination and row values (ch. 7 pp. 147-155), bind parameters vs skewed distributions (ch. 2 pp. 32-35). 2012, rev. 2017 - the per-engine support matrices are dated; verify engine capabilities against current vendor docs.

books.name: PostgreSQL Mistakes and How to Avoid Them (Jimmy Angelakos, Manning 2025)
books.description: PostgreSQL 17-era operational and SQL pitfalls. Used for: NOT IN with nullable subquery returning zero rows and the NOT EXISTS anti-join alternative (section 2.1), work_mem as per-plan-node per-connection and OOM-killer consequences (section 6.2), connection count vs TPS/latency pgbench evidence and the 4x-cores rule of thumb (section 6.3 table 6.1), idle connections and snapshot contention (section 6.4.2), idle-in-transaction blocking DDL and the lock-queue cascade (section 6.5.1). Benchmark figures are specific to the book's test rig - do not port the numbers.

books.name: SQL Antipatterns, Volume 1 (Bill Karwin, Pragmatic Bookshelf 2022)
books.description: Schema and query antipattern catalog. Used for: NULL three-valued-logic truth tables, IS DISTINCT FROM as null-safe comparison, and the NOT IN (NULL) trap (ch. 14 'Fear of the Unknown'); greatest-N-per-group Single-Value Rule violation and the correlated-subquery / window-function / derived-table / join solution ladder (ch. 15 'Ambiguous Groups'). Engine support notes for IS DISTINCT FROM are a 2022 snapshot - SQL Server added it in 2022; verify per engine.

books.name: Database Reliability Engineering (Campbell & Majors, O'Reilly 2017)
books.description: Operating datastores at scale. Used for ch. 7 'Backup and Recovery' (pp. 113-132): recovery-vs-backup framing, planned/unplanned failure-scenario taxonomy, scope and impact dimensions yielding 72 scenario combinations, the four recovery building blocks (detection, tiered storage, varied toolbox, testing), tier-to-use-case mapping, and the 'Replication Is Not a Backup!' sidebar (p. 126). 2017 - cloud service names and tooling have moved on; the design framework has not.

books.name: High Performance MySQL, 4th ed. (Botros & Tinley, O'Reilly 2021)
books.description: MySQL operations at scale. Used for ch. 6 'Schema Design and Management' (pp. 149-152): native INPLACE/INSTANT DDL limits, and the gh-ost vs pt-online-schema-change mechanism comparison - triggers and write amplification vs binlog tailing, gh-ost's foreign-key bail-out as a schema-platform commitment, and the constraint that only native DDL avoids a full table copy. Verify current tool and MySQL version behavior against project docs.
